verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of version history, checkpoints, diff/review, or rollback features for Replit Agent's automations; the only related evidence (replit-comm-5) describes git operations by the agent conflicting with the user's own commits and getting 'stuck in a loop' with no rollback support, and replit-comm-8/9 describe an agent deleting a production database with no recovery mechanism mentioned. Since no first-party or hands-on evidence shows a working versioning/rollback capability for automations, this applicable axis is unmet.
